summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Psyence Biomedical Ltd., a foreign private issuer, to disclose an amendment and restatement of its 2023 Equity Incentive Plan to correct a typographical error in Section 4(b). No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review is present. The filing merely reports a board-approved administrative correction to an equity incentive plan, which is a standard corporate governance matter. Accordingly, it does not constitute a special situation under event-driven analysis.
